event.label: reported
event.text: Shops were looted in Frankfurt on October 31 as demonstrations by the group “Gen Z regelt” turned violent, The Straits Times reported. FAZ wrote that politicians and news presenters have discussed the movement mainly because of the unrest that followed the otherwise peaceful protests.
